name.en: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS)
name.mr: महाविद्यालय व विद्यापीठ विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी केंद्रीय क्षेत्र शिष्यवृत्ती योजना
name.hi: कॉलेज और विश्वविद्यालय छात्रों के लिए केंद्रीय क्षेत्र छात्रवृत्ति योजना

department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India

summary.en: ₹12,000 a year (₹20,000 at PG level) for 12th-board toppers (above the 80th percentile) in regular degree courses, with family income up to ₹4.5 lakh.

text.en: Above the 80th percentile of your 12th board and stream

source.quote: Students who are above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the respective Board of Examination in Class XII

text.en: Regular degree course (not distance, correspondence or diploma)

source.quote: Pursuing regular degree courses and not correspondence or distance mode or pursuing Diploma courses
Students with gross parental/family income upto ₹ 4.5 lakh per annum are eligible

text.en: Not getting any other merit or state scholarship, fee waiver or reimbursement

source.quote: Not availing benefit of any other merit scholarship schemes, State run scholarship schemes, fee waiver, reimbursement scheme.
Income certificate will be required only for the fresh applicants

notes: Applies from academic year 2022-23 onwards; NSP publishes the yearly dates.
Cannot be combined with a state scholarship such as MahaDBT schemes (criterion above).
Renewal needs 50% marks and 75% attendance each year (guidelines 4.viii).
